name: CicadaIG
title: The Cicada Vaccine Forecasting Engine and Guide
description: Example Implementation Guide for using the CDC's Clinical Decision Support for Immunization

resource.name: Allergy Intolerance Profile for Immunization Decision Support
resource.description: Profile for allergy intolerances relevant to immunization. The code (allergen/substance) may use SNOMED CT or ICD-10-CM. Reaction substances may use CVX, MVX, SNOMED CT, or RxNorm.

resource.name: Allowed Interval Reason
resource.description: Captures the reason for the allowed interval between vaccine doses.

resource.name: Allowed Interval Status
resource.description: Captures the status of the allowed interval for vaccination.

resource.name: Allowed Vaccine Reason
resource.description: Captures the reason why a particular vaccine is allowed.

resource.name: Allowed Vaccine Status
resource.description: Indicates if the vaccine administered is allowed under certain conditions.

resource.name: Antigen Needing a Dose
resource.description: An antigen within this vaccine group that needs the forecast dose. A multi-antigen group forecasts as one recommendation, so without this a caller cannot tell whether all of MMR is due or only the measles component. Repeats, one per antigen.

resource.name: AssessmentDate
resource.description: The date on which the vaccination assessment was made.

resource.name: Begin Age
resource.description: The age at which the vaccine becomes applicable.

resource.name: CDSI Observation Codes
resource.description: Observations and Conditions that are important to indications or contraindications in vaccine forecasting

resource.name: CDSI Observation Codes Value Set
resource.description: Every CDSi observation code, as published in the supporting data.

resource.name: Cicada Data Integrity Code System
resource.description: Records that cannot describe an administration. CDSi evaluates a vaccine dose administered and defines the assessment date as the current date, so these doses are excluded from evaluation and forecasting and reported in an OperationOutcome. They are statements about the data, never about the patient's immunity, which is why they are not evaluation statuses.

resource.name: Cicada Data Integrity Value Set
resource.description: Reasons a dose was reported rather than evaluated.

resource.name: Cicada Evaluation Status
resource.description: Extension codes for dose evaluation status beyond the HL7 THO immunization-evaluation-dose-status CodeSystem. Only codes not covered by the standard are defined here.

resource.name: Cicada Forecast Reason Code System
resource.description: Why the engine forecast what it did. The ImmDS ForecastReason code system covers four of these; the rest have no ImmDS concept, and the ImmDS binding on ImmunizationRecommendation.recommendation.forecastReason is example strength, so they travel as a second coding rather than being dropped.

resource.name: Cicada Forecast Reason Value Set
resource.description: Forecast reasons the engine can report.

resource.name: Cicada Immunization Recommendation
resource.description: The forecast cicada returns. Constrains ImmunizationRecommendation to say which series group each recommendation belongs to, so that more than one recommendation for a single vaccine group can be told apart.

resource.name: Condition Profile with Vaccine Condition Codes
resource.description: Profile for conditions where the code must be from the Vaccine Condition Codes value set. Accepts SNOMED CT and ICD-10-CM coded conditions.

resource.name: Contributing Series Detail
resource.description: One contributing series: its own status, its own four dates, and the component dates that produced them. A vaccine group forecast reports the aggregate over several series, so without this a group covered by more than one reports a single answer for all of them, and a due date arrives with no way to see whether age or interval produced it. Repeats, one per series.

resource.name: Dose of a Vaccine
resource.description: Detailed information about each vaccination dose.

resource.name: Dose Status Reason Value Set
resource.description: Value set for dose evaluation status reasons, referencing the published ImmDS IG StatusReason CodeSystem.

resource.name: Doses Remaining
resource.description: How many doses remain in the series after the one being forecast, or 'Recurring' where the series ends in a recurring dose. seriesDoses and doseNumber allow a reader to subtract, but no arithmetic says the series never ends.

resource.name: End Age
resource.description: The age at which the vaccine is no longer applicable.

resource.name: Engine and Supporting Data Version
resource.description: The engine build and the CDSi supporting-data release that produced this resource. A forecast is a function of both, so a stored response naming neither cannot be traced to what produced it. Parameters is not a DomainResource and carries no extension, so the stamp sits on each evaluation and on each recommendation.

resource.name: Evaluation Reason
resource.description: The reason for the evaluation.

resource.name: Evaluation Reason
resource.description: The reason for the evaluation.

resource.name: Evaluation Status Value Set
resource.description: Combined value set for dose evaluation status, including HL7 THO standard codes (valid, notvalid) and the Cicada extension code (extraneous).

resource.name: Evaluation Sub-step Detail
resource.description: The CDSi Chapter 6 sub-step outcomes behind a dose's evaluation: which of age, interval, conflict and vaccine choice passed, and for those that failed, which rule failed. doseStatusReason carries ten ImmDS codes; the engine knows more than that.

resource.name: Forecast Status Value Set
resource.description: Combined value set for immunization forecast status, referencing published standard CodeSystems. Includes ImmDS IG ForecastStatus (CDSi-compatible), HL7 THO immunization-recommendation-status, and LOINC answer list LL940-8.

resource.name: ICD-10-CM to CDSi Observation Code Map
resource.description: Maps ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes to CDSi observation codes used in immunization decision support.

resource.name: Immunization Procedures Profile
resource.description: Profile for medical procedures related to immunization based on SNOMED CT or CPT codes.

resource.name: Immunization-Relevant Medications (RxNorm)
resource.description: RxNorm codes for medications relevant to immunization decision support, including antivirals and aspirin.

resource.name: Immunization-Relevant Procedures (CPT)
resource.description: CPT codes for procedures relevant to immunization decision support, including splenectomy and cochlear implant.

resource.name: Inadvertent Administration Status
resource.description: Indicates if the vaccine was administered inadvertently.

resource.name: Interval Reason
resource.description: This value set includes codes for the reason an interval is considered to be invalid.

resource.name: Interval Reason
resource.description: This value set includes codes for the reason an interval is considered to be invalid.

resource.name: Lab Evidence of Immunity (LOINC)
resource.description: LOINC codes for laboratory tests that provide evidence of immunity, mapped to CDSi observation codes for immunization decision support. Serum IgG in every case, plus total antibody for hepatitis A, which is what evidence of immunity means for these antigens; IgM, cerebrospinal fluid and avidity codes are deliberately excluded.

resource.name: Medication Administration Profile with Vaccine Codes
resource.description: Profile for medication administrations with vaccine codes from CVX or MVX.

resource.name: Medication Dispense Profile with Vaccine Codes
resource.description: Profile for medication dispenses with vaccine codes from CVX or MVX.

resource.name: Medication Request Profile with Vaccine Codes
resource.description: Profile for medication requests with vaccine codes from CVX or MVX.

resource.name: Medication Statement Profile with Vaccine Codes
resource.description: Profile for medication statements with vaccine codes from CVX or MVX.

resource.name: Medications
resource.description: Value set for medications and substances based on SNOMED CT, including both active ingredients and marketed products.

resource.name: Observation Profile for Immunization Decision Support
resource.description: Profile for Observation resources carrying lab evidence of immunity or other findings relevant to immunization decisions. Codes may be from SNOMED CT, ICD-10-CM, or LOINC.

resource.name: Preferred Interval Reason
resource.description: Captures the reason for the preferred interval between vaccine doses.

resource.name: Preferred Interval Status
resource.description: Indicates if the vaccine was administered at the preferred interval.

resource.name: Preferred Vaccine Reason
resource.description: Captures the reason why a particular vaccine is preferred.

resource.name: Preferred Vaccine Status
resource.description: Indicates if the vaccine administered is the preferred vaccine.

resource.name: Procedures
resource.description: Comprehensive Value Set for medical procedures based on SNOMED CT codes.

resource.name: Reasons why certain doses are Preferred or Allowed doses
resource.description: Reasons why certain doses are Preferred or Allowed doses

resource.name: Reasons why certain doses are Preferred or Allowed doses
resource.description: Reasons why certain doses are Preferred or Allowed doses

resource.name: Series Group
resource.description: The series group this forecast is scoped to, per CDSi FORECASTVG-1. recommendation.series names the series; core FHIR has nowhere for the group.

resource.name: Series Type
resource.description: Whether this recommendation came from the standard series group or a risk series group. Present so a client receiving two recommendations for one vaccine group can tell which pathway each describes.

resource.name: Series Type Code System
resource.description: CDSi series type: whether a patient series is the routine schedule, one indicated by a risk condition, or evaluation-only. Mirrors the seriesType attribute of the CDSi antigen supporting data.

resource.name: Series Type Value Set
resource.description: Series types a forecast can be scoped to. In practice a forecast carries standard or risk: CDSi Table 8-14 excludes Evaluation Only series from best patient series.

resource.name: SNOMED CT to CDSi Observation Code Map
resource.description: Maps SNOMED CT codes to CDSi observation codes used in immunization decision support. Generated from CDC's supporting data.

resource.name: Target Dose Status
resource.description: The CDSi target dose status this administered dose produced.

resource.name: Target Dose Status Code System
resource.description: CDSi Table 3-2. The status of the target dose an administered dose was evaluated against. R4 ImmunizationEvaluation carries only doseNumber, derived from this, so a skipped target dose and a satisfied one are otherwise indistinguishable.

resource.name: Target Dose Status Value Set
resource.description: CDSi target dose statuses.

resource.name: Vaccination Conflict
resource.description: Indicates any conflicts with other vaccinations.

resource.name: Vaccination Patient
resource.description: A profile that extends the base FHIR Patient resource to include detailed vaccination-related information.

resource.name: Vaccine
resource.description: Simple vaccine to easily obtain needed information for forecasting

resource.name: Vaccine Condition Codes
resource.description: Value set for conditions based on SNOMED CT, that may impact immunization.

resource.name: Vaccine Condition Codes (ICD-10-CM)
resource.description: Value set for conditions based on ICD-10-CM that may impact immunization decisions, mapped to CDSi observation codes.

resource.name: Vaccine Gender
resource.description: Value set for gender categories relevant to vaccination data.

resource.name: Vaccine Gender
resource.description: Value set for gender categories relevant to vaccination data.

resource.name: Vaccine Type
resource.description: Type of the vaccine.

resource.name: Valid Age Reason
resource.description: Captures the reason why the vaccine was administered at a particular age.

resource.name: Valid Age Reason
resource.description: Value set for reasons why a patient's age is considered valid/invalid for a vaccine.

resource.name: Valid Age Reason
resource.description: Value set for reasons why a patient's age is considered valid/invalid for a vaccine.

resource.name: Valid Age Status
resource.description: Indicates if the vaccine was administered at the correct age.
